title: Editor freezes briefly after closing the game window — Godot 4.6-rc2 and later
body:
### Tested versions

  
Reproducible in: Godot Engine v4.6.rc2.official.78c6632e and later 
Not reproducible in: 4.6-rc1 and earlier
    

### System information

OS: Windows 11 Pro 25H2, Preview Update (KB5124010), build 26200.9550    
GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU    
GPU driver: NVIDIA Studio Driver 616.92 
Graphics API: OpenGL 3.3.0
Display: 2560×1440 at 60 Hz
CPU: Intel Core i7-13700H
RAM: 32 GB
Storage: NVMe SSD

### Issue description

After closing the game window launched with the Run Project shortcut (F5/F6), the editor may freeze briefly if I immediately interact with the 2D or 3D editor. The freeze lasts approximately 5–10 seconds and prevents any interaction with the editor, although it does not lock up the operating system. For example, keyboard shortcuts such as Alt+Tab continue to work even when the mouse appears to be captured.

The issue occurs when the game window is closed using either:

The window's close button (X) OR using Alt+F4

Stopping the project using the editor's Stop button (F8) does not reproduce the issue.

Expected behavior:

As in previous versions, the editor should remain responsive and behave smoothly after closing the game window, without stuttering, glitches, or temporary freezes.

There's how it's look:


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1070a6ac-1bef-42cf-a0c3-40cf6e72f6e0

### Steps to reproduce


1. Run the project using F5, F6, or the Run Project button.
2. Close the game window using the X button or Alt+F4.
3. Immediately try moving around or interacting with the 2D or 3D editor.

   The editor may freeze for several seconds.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)


1. Create a new project.
2. Add a Node3D.


------- 

 ### Additional observations

- The issue occurs in all rendering modes: Forward+, Mobile, and Compatibility.
- It does not appear to depend on whether the project uses DirectX 12 or Vulkan.
- The issue does not occur when using a Node2D instead of a Node3D.
- It occurs more frequently with larger or more complex projects, and the freeze can last longer than 10 seconds.
- I have not observed any obvious spikes in CPU, GPU, or RAM usage during the freeze. However, I have not been able to investigate this thoroughly using Task Manager.
- The issue is intermittent. It may not occur for several consecutive attempts—sometimes up to 10—but then reproduce unexpectedly.
It only occurs when the game window is closed using the X button or Alt+F4. It does not occur when stopping the project with F8.
- Opening or closing the debugger panels does not make any difference.
- The issue is easier to reproduce when the editor is maximized.
- Disabling V-Sync has no effect.
- No errors or additional output appear in the console.
- The issue does not occur in headless mode.


 
Thank you very much to the entire Godot team for your continued work.
